strokesGained.note: Tee-to-green SG is per-shot over recorded shots (penalties & un-sensed shots excluded). Buckets are distance-based (offTee = par4/5 tee; long 150+, mid 50-150, inside-50). sg0to100 is the leverage metric (100yd-and-in, no putts). Putting is count-based (3-putts penalized; totalPutts/threePutts authoritative).

reconciliation.note: Score is authoritative. The sensor shot layer is imperfect: it can under-record (un-sensed short shots; penalties carry no position) or over-record (phantom/practice strokes). Treat shot counts as spatial detail, not stroke truth; discount suspectHoles for club/distance stats. Counts here EXCLUDE phantomShots (between-hole transit logged as strokes); those shots stay in `holes[].shots` flagged with phantom=true.

# Post-round notes — 2026_08_21_379445560

Alright, had another round at Riverside today and shot a 95 -- could tell pretty early it wasn't going to be a 'scoring day' but a decent day of golf.

Overview:
Driver was good and consistent today -- very manageable -- not a bomber, not dead straight but very playable
Long clubs were very good and reliable -- work with my 5W and 4H really paying off and used them confidently and well
Irons -- really still working those new irons in -- need more calibration, and today wasn't a great iron day, but mid-round was able to do feet together drill and reset well carrying the rest of the day well (found I simply was pulling my backswing a bit too wide instead of inside with my irons and corrected -- likely due to long-clubs going with a wide takeaway) -- all in all new irons confirmed go roughly 10y shorter than other irons -- nothing wrong with these, just need more reps and not my best day with them
Putting was really meh -- missed some that should have gone in from 10' and in -- just wasn't 'on', but lag was decent -- not terrible, not great -- nothing really rolling my way today in putting.
Wedges -- poor today -- but not all poor. My pitching was just fine generally -- from 30-70y could use my vokeys well with the pitch shots. My #1 priority is obvious now and was terrible today -- 25y in for 'chipping'. not pitching -- this is something I can definitely improve, but has not been a strong area of focus. Will spend some real time working on this and my game will improve A LOT
Bunkers -- other than H5 as a blow up hole, my bunker shots (3 in all) were very good, think I figured out the clay a bit, going about a half inch behind the ball instead of 2" with soft sand -- really did well with bunkers today

The Turn Breakdown

My breakdown for select holes:

H5 - Par 3, blew up
This one pushes my distance with the new irons with 175 yard tee to hole
took 6i, decent strike, with good distance but landed in tree cover to right of path
Had a poor lie across path with trees overhead, sent into green-side bunker
These are clay packed bunkers and simply got a hold of the ball clean (without sand) and sent it over green, wedged back and ended up in another trap
Just struggle after struggle here.
Poor hole

H7 - Par 4
Decent drive 219y
Absolutely duffed my next shot with 7i and ended up in trees to right
Had to punch out as directly behind tree, decent wedge from there, but 3 putt

H8 - Par 4 - #1 handicap on course
Ended up with a bogey and very well played hole
This one doglegs right, but driver had a strong fade, so went with 5W off tee for straighter shot
Sent it 224 yards straight
Hit my 4h decent but a bit chunky, short to right at 148y
Wedged and 2 putt -- very happy with result - first time not double or worse on hole

H9 - Par 4
Only talk briefly about this hole, drive sliced right, but playable
another bad 7i into bunker
Amazing bunker out with a tap-in for bogey

H10 - Par 3
Irons weren't going great so went with 4h
Sent way left as I hit ground before ball
Playing recovery from there with tress and cart path between green
Pitched to safe spot, wedged and putted from there for triple bogey

H11
Solid recovery here -- realized my irons weren't behaving so did feet together drill to get good strike
Solid strike a bit right to 131y into bunker on right green
Great out, 2 putt in for bogey

H12 Par 5
Usually do well on this hole
I was focused on fixing driver -- meaning was not getting my release well enough causing fades/slices
Unfortunately when I overdo release, often will top the drive which I did here for only 64y
5W awesome recovery cracking ball for 244y
Ended up with another 5w for 149y but for once went very straight (I usually aim a bit left but release was good) - Trees dropped it a bit short
Tough 85y to green with tree overhang having to go over, so sent it a bit over, but overall good shot
Bad wedge shot from there, had to chip again, followed by putt -- double bogey

H15 Par 4
Decent drive 211, but low and short
Great 5w strike for 214y -- however a bit right which made me contend with tree overhangs blocking clean approach
Bad pitch, pitched again followed by 3 putt
